true_leverage.statement: Your lever is deep private research that ends in one visible, named artifact — because the intake side of your chart runs at full power while the output side is nearly dry, and the one element that carries output has just entered your timing.
true_leverage.why_not_others: You might think your lever is handling pressure — Seven Killings sits in the month branch and you do convert deadline strain into delivery. But that conversion only works because Indirect Resource, the study-and-absorb force, is the heaviest signal in your chart at ten, carried openly by the month stem Wu earth and hidden in three branches. Pressure without that study behind it would just be strain. You might also think your lever is defending territory — Direct Wealth and Rob Wealth sit at equal weight, so you guard what you earn. But defense is a maintaining move, not a growing one: it protects value your mastery already created, and it costs you energy in every vague shared assignment. Research-turned-artifact is the only move that uses your strongest force and patches your weakest — the output channels, where Hurting Officer barely registers and the eating-god type is empty.
true_leverage.evidence: Indirect Resource is the heaviest Ten God at ten, seated on the month stem and buried in three branches, feeding a balanced Geng metal day master that thrives on earth and metal. The output elements are the driest point: Hurting Officer barely registers and the eating-god channel is empty. Direct Wealth and Rob Wealth tie at nine, making defense costly by default.

use_cases.scene: A new requirement lands and everyone starts arguing about scope in the meeting.
use_cases.action: Say one sentence — 'give me until Thursday' — then go do what you do naturally: read the standard, the code, the failed attempts, until you know the demand better than the person who wrote it. Then do the part you usually skip: write a half-page brief with your name on it, put it in the shared folder, and read the key finding aloud in ninety seconds at the next session. The study half you already do on instinct; the artifact half is the deliberate addition that turns private mastery into recognized standing.
use_cases.evidence: Indirect Resource at its heaviest means your natural first move is withdrawal into study, and a balanced Geng day master absorbs that input well. The visible chart carries almost no output element, so the artifact step will not happen on its own — it must be a built habit attached to the research you were doing anyway.

use_cases.scene: You are asked to co-own a project with a peer whose reliability you doubt.
use_cases.action: Before any work starts, send a two-sentence note: which parts you own, the deadline, and what happens if a piece is missing on the due date. Then work your own parts at full depth and stop monitoring theirs. When the temptation comes to quietly absorb their slack, refer back to the note instead. This is not distrust — it is converting the ground-guarding energy your chart spends on invisible negotiation into one written boundary, freeing the rest for the deep work that actually builds your position.
use_cases.evidence: Direct Wealth and Rob Wealth sit at equal weight, so shared, vaguely divided ground is where your energy drains fastest. The balanced day master gives you enough reserve to hold the boundary without the exchange turning into open conflict.

use_cases.scene: Your lead asks, 'so what have you been working on these past two months?'
use_cases.action: Answer with the artifact, not the effort: open the document, the demo, or the fix log you attached to the last deep dive and walk through it for five minutes. If nothing attachable exists yet, say 'let me package that — give me a week' and actually do it. This reverses your default pattern, where months of the strongest work in your chart produce nothing anyone can point to, and the pressure force in your month branch discharges into preparation rather than worry.
use_cases.evidence: The luck pillar that began around thirty-eight carries Ren water, the output element the visible chart lacks entirely — meaning the external timing now supports showing work outward at noticeably lower personal cost than the metal-heavy decades before it. Seven Killings held in the month branch gives that showing a use: pressure finally has a place to discharge.

next_90_days.one_thing: Institute the one-artifact rule and prove it on existing work: pick three private notes or studies you have already finished — no new research allowed — and turn each into one shareable artifact, spaced roughly a month apart.
next_90_days.action: Weeks one and two: choose the first finished study and turn it into a half-page document or a recorded five-minute walkthrough, named and dated, in a place others can reach. Weeks three and four: book a real slot — a team session, a forum post, a recorded talk — and present it. Repeat the cycle twice more with the second and third studies. No perfection passes: the standard is 'a colleague could point to it', not 'it is polished'. If a study feels too rough to show, show the roughest version to one trusted person first and record what confused them.
next_90_days.completion_signal: By day ninety you can point to three artifacts carrying your name that existed nowhere outside your private files at day zero, and at least two were seen or heard by someone other than you — a comment, a question, a download, an attendance. That is verifiable: the files have timestamps and the audience has left traces.
next_90_days.evidence: The knowledge already sits finished inside your files because Indirect Resource at ten keeps producing regardless of recognition — the only missing step is outward form. The water luck pillar now running supplies the carrying element the visible chart never had, so this decade the output habit costs less to sustain than it would have earlier, making the ninety-day window the cheap entry point.

falsification_signals.signal: After six to eight genuine attempts at the artifact-plus-presentation pattern, you find that producing the visible layer consistently drains you for days afterward — sleep disrupted, deep-work capacity down the following week — rather than costing effort only at the start. That would suggest the water timing is not feeding this chart the way the structure analysis assumes, and the lever should be re-examined rather than pushed harder.
falsification_signals.what_it_means: The manual predicted that output becomes cheaper in this decade because the luck pillar supplies the missing element. If sustained output measurably degrades your core research capacity instead, the prediction about timing is wrong and this document should be discarded as a guide for how you run.

falsification_signals.signal: You present the artifacts and the environment repeatedly rewards neither depth nor traceable results — over several cycles, the visible, named work earns no new assignments, no standing, and no protection of territory, while the same defense-by-effort pattern you used before continues to be what actually keeps your position. That would mean the environment assumption baked into every recommendation here is false for your specific setting.
falsification_signals.what_it_means: This manual assumed your surroundings decide trust by verifiable output. If your direct observations show the opposite held steady across multiple honest attempts, the advice is calibrated to a world you do not live in — throw it out and analyze the actual rules of your environment instead of forcing this framework onto them.
